name: scope-listener
features: Oscilloscope compares a local file or YouTube video against the phone mic and shows the offset and drift.
Views switch between overlay, split, X-Y, difference, spectrum, waterfall, radial and correlation.
Listen offset mode, nudge half a second, auto track, play, pause, speaker, loop and mic controls work.
Info panel explains what works so far.
overlap: Newer version of phasewell-scope and shares the sync engine with offset-listener. Likely merge host.
